subject: gargoyle
pitch:
Category: Monster.
Subject: cathedral gargoyle crouched on a ledge.
Style: gothic stone carving.

requests.what: Add a small gothic crown of pointed stone finials and a central cathedral quatrefoil behind the gargoyle's horns. Use STONE_LIGHT and STONE_DARK, with sharp carved silhouettes and a few narrow openings.
Deepen both eye sockets with angular gothic eyelid wedges and tiny inset stone pupils. Use GROOVE for the recesses, STONE_DARK for the lids, and EYE_STONE for the small carved eyes.
Add four uneven cathedral-gargoyle fangs descending into the open mouth, two large outer tusks and two short inner teeth. Use STONE_LIGHT with GROOVE shadow bands.

Build raised gothic rib tracery over the left wing: three tapering stone ribs, a pointed trefoil motif, and tiny pointed buttresses at the rib junctions. Use STONE_LIGHT on the ribs and STONE_DARK on the recesses.

Build matching raised gothic rib tracery over the right wing: three tapering stone ribs, a pointed trefoil motif, and tiny pointed buttresses at the rib junctions. Use STONE_LIGHT on the ribs and STONE_DARK on the recesses.
Add three long hooked talons to the left hand, with angular knuckle caps and pointed tips gripping the ledge. Use STONE_LIGHT for the claws and GROOVE at each joint.
Add three long hooked talons to the right hand, with angular knuckle caps and pointed tips gripping the ledge. Use STONE_LIGHT for the claws and GROOVE at each joint.
Add a row of large alternating gothic leaf-spikes along the raised tail, ending in one spearhead-shaped terminal fin. Use STONE_LIGHT with STONE_DARK undersides.
Carve a small gargoyle rain-drain channel directly in front of the creature: a shallow gothic spout with two square side blocks and a dark opening. Use LEDGE_TOP, LEDGE_DARK, and GROOVE.
Add three irregular carved masonry blocks beneath the ledge corners, with tiny triangular chamfers and one broken hanging fragment. Keep them subordinate to the gargoyle and use LEDGE and LEDGE_DARK.

Paint the body with weathered gothic limestone: broad cool gray planes, darker recessed undersides, subtle vertical chisel striations, and sparse pale edge wear. Use STONE, STONE_DARK, STONE_LIGHT, and GROOVE.

Paint the head as hand-carved cathedral stone with darker brow and cheek recesses, pale worn nose and muzzle edges, and small hairline cracks that follow the carving. Use STONE, STONE_DARK, STONE_LIGHT, and GROOVE.

Paint both wing membranes with alternating weathered stone panels: STONE_DARK in the deep folds, STONE on broad slabs, and STONE_LIGHT along the raised rib edges. Keep the pattern radial from the wing roots.

Paint the ledge as old cathedral masonry with block seams, chipped pale top edges, dark damp underside staining, and small moss-green patches only in sheltered cracks. Use LEDGE_TOP, LEDGE, LEDGE_DARK, and MOSS.
